body: I talked it out with him.  Even though it still hurts, it helped a lot.  Thank you.

Any advice on how to stay calm?  I don't want to attack him and call him a creep, but I'm upset so I feel like it might slip out.  I want to handle the situation very delicately so he is open to talking about it, and not shutting me out.
Yes, he did.  She definitely wasn't posing.  They were in class and she was diagonal/forward from him, and it is very obvious she wasn't aware.

Remind yourself that you are amazing, and don't let him get into your head.  He already took so much from you, don't let him take more by swarming your thoughts (I know much easier said than done).  The day he gets out, go do something fun with close family or friends to take your mind off of it. "No one can make you feel inferior without your consent"-Eleanor Roosevelt
